summary.short_summary: Andy Day confirmed his commitment to an immersive experiential roll-up strategy, generating significant interest through social media. He plans to secure $12 million in private debt this Friday for acquiring a profitable business with $4 million EBITDA, aiming to fund acquisitions directly. The discussion highlighted the rapid growth of private credit, surpassing private equity, which supports this strategic direction. Andy operates two advisory firms—Capital A Advisory and Agencies Co—managing about 10 active sell-side mandates, with fees projected between £800,000 to £1.25 million. The competitive landscape includes Go Merge, which dominates the market but faces client dissatisfaction, presenting an opportunity for Agencies Co to capture second-tier market share by enhancing service quality and client relationships.
